dcterms:description: The EmoContext dataset is designed for contextual emotion detection in text, specifically focusing on three emotion classes: happy, sad, and angry, along with an 'others' category. It consists of conversations from Twitter, with a total of 30160 training samples and 2755 development samples.
dcterms:title: EmoContext: Contextual Emotion Detection in Text
